scripts.sync-assets: node -e "if (fs.existsSync('../contract/src/managed/midnight-forge/keys')) fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/midnight-forge/keys', './public/keys', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('../contract/src/managed/midnight-forge/zkir')) fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/midnight-forge/zkir', './public/zkir', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run sync-assets && node -e "fs.rmSync('./dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && vite build --mode preprod && node -e "if (fs.existsSync('./public/keys') && !fs.existsSync('./dist/keys')) fs.cpSync('./public/keys', './dist/keys', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('./public/zkir') && !fs.existsSync('./dist/zkir')) fs.cpSync('./public/zkir', './dist/zkir', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build:preview: npm run sync-assets && node -e "fs.rmSync('./dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && vite build --mode preview && node -e "if (fs.existsSync('./public/keys') && !fs.existsSync('./dist/keys')) fs.cpSync('./public/keys', './dist/keys', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('./public/zkir') && !fs.existsSync('./dist/zkir')) fs.cpSync('./public/zkir', './dist/zkir', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:start:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run start
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
